blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A mobile application developed in Mindoro aims to make tricycle commuting more convenient while providing local drivers with additional income opportunities through digital ride-booking services. Developed by 34-year-old entrepreneur Rhaiven Rein Pasno, Tamarraw Go allows passengers to book tricycle rides, view estimated fares and request rides through their mobile phones. Pasno conceptualized the application with his wife, Lady-lyn Maranan, an entrepreneur who operates an online shop, and his late younger brother, John Michael Pasno, an information technology graduate, who took part in the initial discussions and planning stages.
